story_title: A Day at the Training Center
paragraphs: At a military training center, Lieutenant Ellis leads an advanced English session in the history room. The group studies a glossary of military terms. "If an instructor {{mask_1}} a term on the board, each trainee {{mask_2}} it in the vocabulary notebook," Ellis says. The first card reads lieutenant. "If a learner {{mask_3}} this rank, the glossary {{mask_4}} that it is an officer rank."

The next card describes airborne troops, who are trained to deploy from aircraft, often by parachute. Ellis explains, "If a reader {{mask_5}} the word airborne, the definition {{mask_6}} how it relates to aircraft." A visitor asks about a caption on an old map. "If a caption {{mask_7}} unclear, the reader {{mask_8}} the note beside the map for more context."

A display about the Second World War includes the term Blitzkrieg. The label explains that it is a German word meaning "lightning war," commonly used for fast, coordinated military campaigns in that historical period. "If a visitor {{mask_9}} this term, the exhibit {{mask_10}} its historical meaning," Ellis says. "If someone {{mask_11}} a reference book, the checkout sheet {{mask_12}} who has it." She reminds the group that historical terms make more sense when they are read in context.

The next section introduces logistics: the planning and coordination of people, equipment, and supplies. "If a trainee {{mask_13}} an unfamiliar term, the instructor {{mask_14}} its meaning with an example," Ellis explains. "If a glossary {{mask_15}} a pronunciation guide, the audio guide {{mask_16}} it aloud." The group listens, takes notes, and compares the definitions with the captions.

Before the session ends, Ellis reviews the center's general safety procedures. "If an alarm {{mask_17}}, everyone {{mask_18}} the posted instructions and checks in at the designated assembly area." She adds, "If a person {{mask_19}} an injury, the nearest trained responder {{mask_20}} the medical team." The trainees discuss the new vocabulary and leave with a clearer understanding of both the terms and their historical context.
